text: [Overview] Ayurveda encompasses three fundamental doshas: Vata, Pitta, and Kapha. Vata governs movement, Pitta governs transformation and digestion, and Kapha governs structure. Equilibrium of doshas represents Swasthya (health), while imbalance produces Roga (disease).

text: [Rogi Pariksha] Examination of the patient involves Ashtavidha Pariksha: Nadi, Mutra, Mala, Jihva, Shabda, Sparsha, Druk, and Akruti.
title: clinical_methodology.md

text: [Roga Pariksha] Examination of the disease involves Nidana Panchaka: Nidana (etiology), Purvarupa (premonitory symptoms), Rupa (manifest clinical symptoms), Upashaya (exploratory therapy), and Samprapti (pathogenesis).
title: clinical_methodology.md

text: [Chikitsa Sutra] Therapeutic principles encompass Shodhana (purification) and Shamana (pacification).
